## Clearance and slopes: where a monster will be when her attack starts, and what a jump's attack takes (from 2026-10-27)

The user, 2026-10-27 (about 02:00), having watched her hunt Tree Dungeon: "Is there a strategy to avoid standing at the same X pos as a mob (maintaining a minimum distance from mob)? I frequently find the player standing at the same X pos as the mob, doing jump hit but couldn't hit the mob because no minimal clearance is maintained. I also find jump attack is extremely hard to hit a mob on a down slop, even slightly." Two diagnoses of the live hunts of 2026-10-25 23:43 to 10-26 23:47 (14 on Tree Dungeon, 186 minutes and 6,301 attacks out of darts' spells: `D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/diag-clearance` and `diag-slopes`, read only) bear both out and find why:
- **From a jump the star's search alone picks.** Her Lucky Seven key from a jump took MP on 93-97% of throws at every distance (113 of 119 at 0-20 ahead), where from the ground under 90 ahead only 27% did (the claw's swipe, 15-24): in the air the client never whacks, and RustMS's port of the v83 client has no case for the air. In place and not turning, her throws hurt a monster on her platform 40% of the time 0-40 ahead (middle to middle, its track at the pick), 79% at 40-60 and 81% at 60-130; her casts in place killed one 0-10 ahead 1 time in 31, 10-20 2 in 25, 20-30 5 in 32, 30-40 16 in 43 (37%, as farther off); by eye on the recordings, 0 of 9 at one on or under her (within 25), 1 of 3 at 25-40. Nothing is picked until the body's far side is past 65 ahead (a mushroom's middle at 37), where the claw's reach ends and the star's search begins (`PointBlank.h`, `MAX_REACH = 65`): in the air those 65 units are dead space. `reach.air_takes` took a body from 0 ahead, and so did the simulator's world.
- **An air turn starts the attack 30 units higher.** A jump throw that turns her in the air has its attack 120 ms after the jump key (her feet 52-56 up when it picks, against 21-26 keyed 40 ms after it). Of the in-place jump throws at a monster on her platform 40-130 ahead (its track at the pick, every track of her platform there: `diag-clearance/attacks.jsonl`, the review's full set), keyed 40 ms after the jump key 69% hurt one 5 or more below her (32% killed), 88% level (54%), 91% above (54%); turning 31% (8%), 39% (22%) and 57% (36%) (`D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/fin/live/final_replay.py`); and 63 of 246 that turned her faced away from the target after it (26%). Her and the monsters' heights follow the slopes exactly (perception's y is the floor's `y_at` in all 23,026 reads; every platform from 6 to 33 slopes, 0.38-0.58 a unit at the steepest, 11-36 units along one), and master's `stance._close_quarters` decided on `reach.air_hits(top, key)`, as if the monster stood level with her. (Until the reviews these figures were diag-slopes' 788 throws, which leave out those whose target its frames didn't show, about 45%, and the downhill deficit with them: 76% above, 70% level, 80% below.)
- **She got that close.** A monster on her platform within 60 of her 8.7 s a minute: 27% of her attacks (6.1 EXP an attack there, against 9.5 with nothing within 105), 30% of her touches (0.20 a second there, against 0.096). 41% of those episodes began with a landing, 20% with a touch, 11% with a monster walking in during her lock: Greens and Hornies walk 67-70% of the time at a median 95 units/s, and from the look a throw from the ground was decided on to its attack's start was 0.66 s (0.24 for a jump throw), so 86 of 632 ground throws decided as stars had the target under 93 at the pick, 51 of their 80 casts swipes. Cornered: 27 of the 40 cases seen by eye were at a platform's end against the tower's wall, and the room behind her was a median 61.

**What this changes, and what it doesn't.** It changes which throw she makes up close, not how close she gets: her landings, where 41% of the close episodes began, aren't touched, and in the simulator the time she spends within the claw's reach of a monster is the same as master's (below). From a jump she no longer turns in the air at a monster on her platform (she taps the arrow on the ground first and keys the attack 40 ms after the jump key), she no longer counts on a jump's attack taking one it can't, she claws one standing on her, and a monster walking at her no longer has her turn round to throw at her empty back. Downhill, jump throws still hurt less than level ones, and nothing she could throw instead does better there (On a slope, below).

**From a jump, the star's search alone** (`reach.AIR_MODEL` 'search'; 'widening', the area about her feet and the windows past it, as from 2026-10-25, puts the area back). `air_takes` is the search from her feet when the attack starts: band k from 65 + 20k ahead, its window 12 - 5k to 44 + 5k above her feet then; `in_area` the same for one on her own platform (on a slope it can be 36 lower than her) or on her level or above it; `air_sure` what an attack keyed some ms after the jump key surely picks, at both ends of its start (`ATTACK_DECIDE_LAG_MS`), `AIR_MARGIN` into it, its feet on the slope where it will be: keyed 40 ms after the jump key, a Green or Horny Mushroom on her level or above from 44 ahead, 10 below her takeoff from 64, 15 below from 84, 20 below from 104; keyed 120 ms (an air turn's), on her level from 144, 10 above her from 104. `turn_key_ms` is 120 for every kind (what the search picks goes by the distance as much as the height, and keyed sooner after the arrow the turn goes wrong more often), and `air_hits` the first band's window from her feet (a mushroom keyed 40 ms after the jump key, not a pig or a slime). On the 788 throws the search fits 111 log-likelihood better than the area (-587 against -699, a picked target hurt 72.5% of the time and others' hits 10% of the rest: `D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/impl/calib/fitworld.py`), its floor of 12 best (8 and 16 worse by 7 and 9: `diag-slopes/fit_floor.py`); the planned jumps at monsters 40 or more above her hurt 34-36% of the time whatever the model (`fit_top.py`). The probes' scorer keeps the area as its 'area' answer (`in_area(..., model="widening")`).

**Where it will be** (`stance.Pace`, `fight.pace_of`, `stance.too_close`). Every decision about a monster on her platform goes by where it will be when the attack starts: `lead`, what's left of her attack lock (`Actions.lock_until`) and the look's age; the attack's own key (`GROUND_PICK_S`: the key's `JUMP_LAG` and half the decide lag; a tap first `TAP_S` more; a jump's key after the jump key, `jump_pick_s`; a tap and its wait first, `physics.JUMP_THROW_TURN_MS`, moved there from control.actions); its walk by its track (the feed's `Scene.tracks`, its kind and platform within `TRACK_MATCH` (25), seen in `TRACK_SEEN` (3) frames: its filtered `vx`), and where it was seen for one whose walk nothing tells (no such track; one the look didn't see, hidden under its damage numbers or remembered: had they walked at her, the fights threw at the ghosts of what the camps on 33 killed); with no feed, its pose. One walking at her stops where its body meets hers, on the side of her it was seen on (`PACE_STOP`: its half and `HER_HALF` from her x): it touches her there, and the touch's knock (about 58 units) leaves it on that side. Replayed on the 839 live close-up decisions whose target's track at the pick is known (`D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/fin/live/pace_stop.py`, each walk matched to the service's tracks record nearest the look as `pace_of` does): the 217 walking at her that reach her by the pick were a median 49 from her middle then (10% under 15, 10% over 88), 207 of them on the side the look saw them; stopped so, they're placed 19.8 off on average, walked on through her 32.6, stopped at her x 29.5, left where they were seen 27.1 (all 839: 15.5, 18.8, 18.0, 20.1). As first built (the reviews') they walked through her, and right after a throw (her lock 0.7-0.8 s yet) a walker within about 85 in front had her tap round and throw at her empty back: 86 such throws in its Tree goldens, none in master's, 24 in 16 harness runs (8 of them hurting anything: the reviews'). And with no walk known it walked at her at its kind's speed (`WALK_AT`, True as first built): those 46 are 20.8 off where they were seen, 42.8 walked at her (`walk_at.py`). Who's too close (the hunt loop's rule 1, a trip's stop, the stance) goes by it: a Green 150 off walking at her with her keys free in 0.6 s is 86 off when a throw from the ground would start, inside its claw's edge (105), where live that throw was decided as a star and swiped.

**Up close** (`stance._close_quarters`, `_from_here`, `_clear_step`, `jump_reach`; `_escape`). The nearest close monster where it will be decides. The throw from where she stands whose attack surely takes it then: from the ground if every monster that way is past its claw's edge then; else a jump in place keyed so that it does (`air_sure` at `CLEAR_MARGIN`, 10, farther: the tracks' error; live the no-turn throws hurt 79% from 40), keyed 40 ms after the jump if she faces it, else turning in the air where that picks it, else tapping the arrow on the ground first and jumping keyed 40 ms after the jump key (`JumpPlan(40, 0, air_turn=False, "tap first")`: "jump-throwing right at 40 ms, tap first"). With none sure, a step away to where her next one will (`_clear_step`: the shortest within `STEP_AWAY` and the room there is, her walk by `physics.hold_ms` and `STEP_SETTLE_S` (0.25 s), then the tap and a throw from the ground past its claw's edge, or the tap, the wait and the jump; never into a monster's body, nor to where one walking at her would be on her when the throw starts (`Pace.meets`), and the jump only where none lands her on a platform overhead): against one standing or flinching a step of 15-85, against one walking at her none on these platforms (she gains 54 units for each 149 she walks, less what it walks while she starts and stops). Else a jump back (it buys room: its own attack, after its turn in the air, picks one on her level only from about 145), else the throw from where she is all the same: the claw from the ground within `CLAW_ONLY` (15: her on it) or under a platform overhead, the jump in place beyond it (a cast 20-30 ahead does about twice a swipe's damage on average live, 0-10 about as much for its 14 MP). `jump_reach`, a jump in place's reach on her level (`CLEAR_MARGIN` in: a Green or Horny Mushroom 54, a slime 73, a pig 88, a snail 143), says which kinds a jump in place takes at all inside the claw's reach: a snail never (the old `JUMP_THROW_SNAILS` rule, from the geometry now). A kind that hits hard (`Danger.keep_off`: on Tree Dungeon the Horny Mushroom) is escaped as before (`_escape`: a jump back, a step of `STEP_AWAY`, 120, or the room there is, or the throw from where she stands, by the danger each leaves her in), the throw from where she stands weighed with `ESCAPE_THROW` too where it isn't sure; so the steps of 15-85 are from the other kinds, and from a Horny Mushroom she still steps 120. Her steps and jumps back keep to `drop_limits` (`DROP_ROOM` from an end with a long drop under it) as before.

**On a slope** it's the same picture: the search's windows from her feet at the attack's start against the monster's feet where it will be (`Platform.y_at`), so a monster down the slope from her is taken by a jump in place keyed 40 ms after the jump key only from farther off (10 below from 64, 15 from 84), and by an air turn's later attack not at all up close: tapping first keeps the attack 30 units lower. That's what changes there: of the 52 live in-place throws turning in the air at one 40-130 ahead and 5 or more below her (31% hurt it, 8% killed it), the branch taps first at 42 and throws from the ground at 6, and keyed 40 ms after the jump key those throws hurt 69% of the time live, 32% killed. The search's windows don't explain the rest of the downhill deficit: of the no-turn throws 40 ms after the jump key, by how far the target's top reached into the deepest window of the bands its body spans (at the attack's later start, `D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/fin/live/depth_slope.py`), those downhill killed it 35% of the time at 10-20 into it, 25% at 20-30 and 38% at 30 or more, level ones 40%, 41%, 44%, and over all depths the downhill ones 30%, level 41%, uphill 55% (hurt 67%, 76%, 85%). A margin into the window doesn't make the downhill ones better: called sure only 10, 15, 20 or 25 into it they killed 33%, 31%, 29% and 36% (hurt 74%, 72%, 74%, 77%), the ones it would call not sure 26-31% (`depth_fine.py`). Nor does another throw do better there: from the ground 110-300 ahead at one on her platform, downhill 28% killed (69% hurt), level 35% (75%), uphill 21% (57%) (`D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/fix/live/fitground.py`). So `air_sure` has no slope-dependent margin (the reviews' suggestion: a target more than 5 below not sure): that would only have her step or wait where the jump does as well as anything. What makes the downhill ones miss more isn't known: by kind, distance, walk and platform the gap holds (`fix/live/slope_conf.py`: 40-60 ahead 14% killed downhill against 34% level, 46% hurt against 69%).

**The simulator, made to miss as live** (`world.AIR_PICK` 'search', `World.air_search`; `Noise.air_squash`, `air_short`, `air_short_ramp`, `air_under`, `air_turn_lost`, fitted as `world.TREE_AIR` and in the crowd presets; `Realism.air_pick` for a scenario of an earlier picture: `probe_air` keeps the area's; `Her.claw` and `World._uncast`; `World.pick_log`, `claw_ms`, `close_ms` and the harness's `picks`, `claw_s`, `close_s`, `swiped_casts`, `air_turns_lost`).
- From a jump the world picks by the star's search from her feet then; with the noise, each monster's top is drawn lower for it (uniform over its height, per attack and monster: `air_squash` 1.0, so the search picks a body the likelier the farther its top reaches into a window, as live: the straight throws whose target's top reached 0-10 into the deepest window hurt it 60% of the time, 10-20 71%, 20-30 82%, 30 or more 91%), a monster on her platform short of the first band takes the star now and then, the less the farther short it is (0.3 at the band's edge, none 25 short: `air_short`, `air_short_ramp`), one under a window 30% of the time (`air_under`, by the key the same), and an arrow in the air may not turn her (26%, the live share facing away after one). Fitted by likelihood to the 838 live in-place jump throws with the target's track at the pick and ahead of her middle (530 straight, 308 turning), by their kills and by their bar drops (`D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/fix/live/fitsoft.py`, `fitramp.py`): log-likelihood by kills -449.2 against -466.6 for the first fit (a flat 0.3 short and under, on diag-slopes' 788) and -478.6 for the search alone; by the bar drops -353.1, -370.0 and -380.4. The ground throws 110-300 ahead fit no better drawn so (-236.6 against -238.9 by the bar drops), and have no slope deficit to fit (above): nothing changes from the ground.
- From the ground the Lucky Seven key swipes up close as the attack key does: its cast's MP and stars given back, the swipe 15-24 (`LEVEL_25.claw`), where the world had it take a cast's damage and MP.
- On the live throws' own geometry, the world's pick (`fix/live/bins2.py`: its rule on each throw's bodies, at both ends of the attack's start; picked, hurt 75% of the time and killed 70% for a Green, 45% for a Horny Mushroom, the fit's) against live, killed (hurt by the bar drops in brackets):

  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | keyed 40 ms after the jump key: live | 3% (33%) | 8% (24%) | 16% (41%) | 37% (55%) | 37% (70%) | 38% (76%) | 54% (85%) | 31% (66%) | 38% (74%) | 58% (89%) |
  | ... the world | 7% (26%) | 9% (29%) | 18% (38%) | 27% (54%) | 36% (65%) | 40% (67%) | 45% (77%) | 32% (62%) | 38% (66%) | 50% (80%) |
  | ... the world as first fitted | 17% (38%) | 16% (38%) | 18% (38%) | 23% (54%) | 36% (74%) | 36% (73%) | 35% (74%) | 34% (74%) | 36% (73%) | 38% (74%) |
  | turning in the air: live | 20% (30%) | 5% (22%) | 11% (33%) | 5% (15%) | 21% (38%) | 22% (43%) | 26% (51%) | 12% (33%) | 23% (44%) | 32% (52%) |

  By kills every cell within 10 points of live's, the slope's gradient in it (32/38/50 against 31/38/58), where as first fitted it had none (34/36/38) and the point-blank ones killed twice as often as live. In the harness's own runs the measure isn't the same (the nearest monster ahead on her platform at the pick, whatever the throw was at: jumps at monsters above her count too), and master's stack's straight jump throws there hurt that one 10%, 44% and 48% of the time 0-40, 40-60 and 60-130 ahead (the hunt loop; grinding 13%, 35%, 52%), against live's 33%, 60% and 81% so counted (`fix/live/harness_bins_live.py`): harsher than live 40 ahead and more, which costs the branch nothing it gains (both stacks run in it).

**Out of darts, up close and at a rope's top** (`behavior/darts.py`). A Lucky Seven press from the ground at a monster within the claw's reach of where she stood in the last look (`Attacks._clawed`, `reach.claw_chance`; `Actions.keyed_ground`) is no press of out of darts' stretch (`DartWatch.cast`'s `swipe`): the key swipes it as the attack key does, no MP taken whatever her darts, and with the claw at one on her a whole Horny Mushroom pinning her at a platform's wall end (Tree Dungeon's 6, 7, 13, 15, 19, 20 and 31; 21.1 swipes from whole) would have stopped the hunt with her darts in her bag (the reviews': the branch clawed one standing on her in 222 of Tree Dungeon's stand placements, master in 18). A hunt's end says how many there were ("N from the ground at a monster the claw reaches: not counted"). And the presses out of darts doesn't count (the regular attack's, the claw's swipes) keyed with her look placed at a rope's top (`DartWatch.at_top`, `regular`: within `ROPE_TOP_X` of the top of a rope hanging from her platform), 3 in a row with no kill of hers and each 3 more, have the message bar read as Lucky Seven's do, and the rope's refusal there gets her off it ("the game refused her presses: ... (3 in a row at a rope's top, the regular attack's or the claw's)"): in the simulator `tour_tree_run` (the scenarios throw the regular attack) hung 31.9 s on the rope at x 146 under 30 after a touch cut her climb, placed on 30 at its top, 37 presses refused and none heard (master's stack, in this world, isn't touched there on that seed); now she's up onto 30 2.7 s after the touch, 3 refused. With the swipes left out of the stretch and not watched so, `loop_tree_rope_top_15` hung 14.8 s at the top of the rope at x 111 (31 presses at a Green 73 off, in the claw's reach from where she was placed), where master's 3.5 s; now 2.7 s. Whether the game refuses the regular attack on a rope with that line too, as the simulator does, isn't known (the refusals of 2026-10-26 were Lucky Seven's). The Tree Dungeon hunt scenarios check that she never hung so (`scenarios.NO_HANG_REFUSED`: at most 10 of a hunt's attacks refused; the reviews': `loop_tree_grind` as first recorded hung 86 s on the rope at x -8, 84 attacks refused, and met everything it checked).

**Replayed on the live decisions** (`D:/MapleHelper-scratch/clear/fin/live/final_replay.py`, read only, on `fix/live/R.py`: every live attack decided from a look with a monster of her platform in it, her on the ground, through the branch's `stance` with its pace: her lock and the look's age off the attack record, each monster's walk off the perception service's tracks record nearest the look, matched as `pace_of` matches them): 1,074 of the 1,414 were decided up close.

| a jump in place, no turn (310) | the same 186, tapping first 51, a throw from the ground 45, a step 17, a jump back 4 |
| a jump in place turning in the air (300) | tapping first 231, a jump in place 31, a throw from the ground 18, a step 10 |

Where the branch would do what she did, its own verdict at the decision (`Here.sure`, from the look and its pace) against what came of it live: a jump in place it calls sure hurt the target 86% of the time (63 of 73; 41% of the 100 killed it), one it doesn't 87% (47 of 54; 43% of 86); a throw from the ground it calls sure 74% (102 of 137; 28%), one it doesn't 39% (16 of 41; 10%). From the ground the verdict tells (the claw's swipe from a star); from a jump it doesn't: where the branch has the target when the attack starts and where its track had it then are 26 units apart on average, as wide as the windows' margins. (As first built this paragraph had 84% against 33%: the model judged at the target's track at the pick, which the branch doesn't know when it decides.) Nor is swapping a throw from the ground for a jump in place proven: the live ground throws the branch would make jumps in place hurt 62% of the time (37 of 60; 19% of 118 killed), those it keeps 66% (131 of 199; 22% of 281) (`fix/live/decide_check.py`).

At a monster's x: live, the in-place jump throws whose target was under 40 ahead at the pick came 0.51 a minute (0.11 with no turn, 47% hurt, 24% killed; 0.40 turning in the air, 22% hurt, 8% killed); at those 95 decisions the branch would jump in place 85 times, 76 of them tapping first (keyed 40 ms after the jump key, as the no-turn ones were), throw from the ground 8 and step 2: with no step that clears it nor room for a jump back there's no better throw, and keyed early, not turning, the jump hurt twice as often live. Downhill, of the 52 live in-place throws turning in the air at one 40-130 ahead (31% hurt, 8% killed), the branch taps first at 42 and throws from the ground at 6.

No death, no fall out of the map, no stop in any of the 96 runs, no throw at an empty side with a monster within 105 behind her (24 in 16 runs as first built, the reviews'). The branch all but ends the air turns at a monster on her platform (9.0 turning throws a run against 1.5 on the hunt loop, 8.3 against 1.7 grinding), its throws and casts hit nothing less often, and it drinks fewer MP potions; EXP, kills, HP and the time within the claw's reach of a monster are level with master's within the seeds' noise both ways (the hunt loop -2.8%, se 3.1%; grinding -0.3%, se 2.6%). It doesn't keep her farther from the monsters: her jumps at the nearest under 40 ahead are fewer by the air turns alone (1.87 a minute against 1.45 on the hunt loop, 1.62 against 1.19 grinding), and they hurt it 7-13% of the time either way in this world. Her steps away are 1.3-1.9 times master's, most of 15-50 (master's 40-90 and 120), 39-46% followed by a touch within 1.2 s (34-41%). On the hunt loop her trips are touched more (+2.7 a run, t 2.3) and take longer (56.8 s a run against 48.4): the reviews found it where a jump onto a platform lands her by a monster the takeoff's look didn't have (25 down to 24 touched 21 times in 38 against 9 in 29, "waiting for the green-mushroom to move off" and jumping into it again, a loop master's stack has too: the navigator's); grinding, the other way (-1.4). Two checks gave no reason to change: the claw up to 30 off instead of 15 (`CLAW_ONLY` 30: `fin/trees/c30b`, against the branch before its swipes at a rope's top were watched, `b2`) made 314.4 EXP a minute on the hunt loop where 318.5 (-1.3%, se 2.4%), 333.6 grinding where 342.0 (-2.4%, se 2.6%), HP lost 8% less on the hunt loop (t -2.9) and 2% more grinding, its jumps at the nearest under 40 a quarter fewer on the hunt loop (t -2.2) and as many grinding; and the reviews' "a target more than 5 below not sure" has nothing to gain on the live throws (On a slope, above). **Goldens** (Tree Dungeon's only; other maps' left as they are, not checked). Of the 28, 9 the same to the byte as master's (the `nav_tree_*` but `nav_tree_rope_hit`, and `loop_tree_mp_runs_out`), 19 recorded again, each still showing what it's there for; first apart from master's:

## Landings with clearance, and moving away to attack (from 2026-10-27)

The user, 2026-10-27, asked whether landing with clearance from monsters should be the next fix: "Please do, the character should actively try to move away from the mob to attack it." Two diagnoses of the live hunts of 2026-10-25 23:43 to 10-26 23:47 (14 on Tree Dungeon, 189 minutes: `D:/MapleHelper-scratch/land/diag-landings` and `diag-move-away`, read only), with the reviews' corrections:
- **She landed by monsters, and once down could seldom move away.** By the perception service's live tracks she landed within 105 of a monster on the platform she came down on 2.4 times a minute (her trips' and falls' landings 1.7 of them), median 45 units off; counted with the hidden tracks too, 3.9 a minute, but by eye on the recordings 7 of the 7 such landings by a live track had a monster 10-60 off, 2 of the 9 by hidden tracks alone (the rest Green or Horny Mushroom cap drops, another player's kill dying, nothing), and 2 of 5 with nothing near had a respawn fading in 80-130 off (the reviews: `D:/MapleHelper-scratch/land/review-numbers/eye`). From 67% of those landings by live tracks (303 of 451) the stance had no attack sure to take it. Once down the room behind her was a median 49, inside the 50 she kept from an end with monsters about (no step at all in 77%): a step clearing it 10% of the time, a jump back 0.1%; after a close landing her first attack came 0.73 s on and she stepped or jumped away within 2 s 8% of the time. A not-sure landing cost 5.7 EXP (se 1.7) and 0.13 touches (se 0.07) in the 3 s after it, against a sure one. Of the close landings from another platform only 1.25 a minute (0.73 by live tracks) were a trip's last onto its own platform, out of 4.22 (the reviews'): most came on the way.
- **Up close, moving away along the platform seldom makes her next attack sure.** 69% of the time the monster too close walks at her (a median 95 units/s against her 149: she gains 54 units for each 149 she walks; of 92 live steps away from a walker, the gap 1 s on was 1 unit larger), and what keeps a walker off is hitting it while it's still far: hurt walkers 120-300 off came on 19 units after her key and stopped until 0.9 s (unhurt, 36 by 0.6 s, 43 by 0.9, 50 by 1.2; and those not read 52 and 69). A step helps against one standing or walking away (24% of the decisions), and master's was mostly blocked by the 50 she kept from every end, wall ends included: 27 of the 40 close cases seen by eye were against the tower's wall. 55 of the 93 first clearing steps ended within 50 of a spawn point of her platform.

So her landings are priced before she lands by what her first attack there surely takes, the monster making a trip's last landing so is shot first where a star reaches it from where she takes off, and up close she moves away where that makes her next attack sure, with the room a wall end leaves her. The reviews of 2026-10-27 found the first build's landing price all but inert in the simulator (it priced a trip's last move alone, where a third of the landings by monsters came, against the chain's tracks alone), its shoot-first, walk and wait paths never run, the simulator's walkers stuck to her, and a dozen smaller faults; below as fixed.

**What her attack surely takes** (`reach.ground_sure`; `stance.landing`, `landing_of`, `first_attack_s`, `Landing`). `reach.ground_sure(half)` is the one near and far limit of what her attack from the ground surely takes (the thief's: from the claw's edge, 105 for a mushroom, to `SHOT_RANGE`), and what `too_close`, `close_to`, `_from_here`, `_clear_step` (through `star_sure`, `STAR_SURE_MARGIN` 3 past it) and the landing price all go by: the seam S1's aim facade replaces. A landing is priced by her first attack there (`first_attack_s`: `LANDING_SETTLE_S` and `GROUND_PICK_S` after it, the one helper the stance's jumps and the navigator's judge both use): each monster on the platform where it will be then, walked by its track, one walking at her stopping where it meets her; the nearest surely taken if a throw from the ground takes it there (`ground_sure`) or, for an attack she makes from a jump (`air`: the thief's Lucky Seven; not Magic Claw, cast from the ground only, `character.AttackSpec.air`) and with no platform overhead, a jump in place keyed 40 ms after the jump key does (`air_sure`, `CLEAR_MARGIN` farther, on the slope as it is: from 54 on level ground, 74 one 10 down the slope); one of a kind that hits hard from its keep-off (`Danger.keep_off`: a Horny Mushroom 169); one whose body meets hers by then `meets`. A nearest one past `ground_sure`'s far end costs nothing (as first built a Green 500 off on the 530-wide floor was priced as one 52 off). The price `LANDING_PRICE_S` (1.2 s of hunting: the live 5.7 EXP and 0.13 touches of a not-sure landing, a prior) where it isn't sure, `MEET_PRICE_S` (2.5 s: a touch) more where one meets her; a price, not a veto.

**A chain's landings** (`motion.flow.chain`'s `price`, `alts`, `goal`, `spread`: `Flow._priced`, `_spread`, `_at_rest`, `PRICE_EVERY_MOVE`; `control.navigator._pricing`, `QUEUE_SPREAD`; `behavior.fight.FightOnTheWay.landings`, `STALE_S`, `UNSEEN_PRICE`, `MID_MEETS`). Every move of a chain whose first way lands with a price is done where it lands the cheapest, not only the route's last (`PRICE_EVERY_MOVE`: of the 76 trip landings within 105 of a monster in 8 runs of the first build, `landdiag.py`, 26 came at a move before the route's last or at the end of a chain cut short, 25 at the route's last onto the trip's platform, 15 were knocks' falls, 8 the mover's lone moves, 2 neither; of those whose monster the navigator tracked, most were of chains gone past it regardless, `_meet`'s last resort, landing on it, and the others' the navigator didn't have: off the look's band, a drop 200-400 down, or missed), the next move following on from there: the route's last move by when she stands where she lands, the dearer of its price at the touchdown and where she comes to stand (a running end's stop and slide on: as first built judged at the touchdown alone, 14 units short, so 'run' won the ties by its slide's 0.19 s), and her walk on to where she's sent; a move before it by the touch alone of a monster seen walking into her where it lands (`MID_MEETS`: she runs on from there; priced in full, as the trip's last, grinding made 5.6% less EXP than master's stack where 2.5%, the hunt loop 7.3% where 6.1%, 24 seeds, se 3%). Tried for it: its own ways, the route's other moves between the same platforms (their own ways too, walk-offs and climbs as well: as first built only those with wider take-offs), and wider take-offs (a running jump from 40 either way of its own every 5, a jump straight up from anywhere under the platform above every 10, every fifth of a drop's spots); and the cheaper only where one lands priced less than the first (as first built a price the same everywhere still changed take-off and variant: 354 of 478 Tree route-move chains, the reviews'). A chain planned on the move (`_queue_next`) tries no wider take-offs (`QUEUE_SPREAD`): with them a priced chain took a median 10 ms more to plan (45 at p90, 62 at the most, with the harness running alongside), without them 0.7 (3, 3.9), against `SEND_S`'s 30. The judge prices the tracks seen within `STALE_S` (a death's fade, 1.5 s) in full; an older one (by eye 2 of the 9 live landings by hidden tracks alone had a monster there) and the spawn points none of the platform's tracks accounts for at `UNSEEN_PRICE` (0.25, a prior) of that, with no track making it so (nothing to shoot first or wait out): her landings off the spawn points where nobody's seen. With it grinding is within 60 of a monster 12% less of the time where with 0 5.5% (below), and the hunt loop's trips are 5% longer.

**A trip's last landing** (`navigator._clear_landing`, `LANDING_CLEAR`, `LANDING_WALK`, `SHOOT_WALK`, `LAND_WAITS`; `FightOnTheWay.shoot_from`, `stance.shooting_place`). Where the cheapest landing onto the trip's platform still has a price a monster the look saw makes, it's shot first from where she stands if a star reaches it ("horny-mushroom at x 21 by her landing on 23: shooting it first", `clear_for`), else walked to along her platform within `SHOOT_WALK` (150) where one does, with no monster of her platform in the walk's way (`shooting_place`), and shot there (`shoot_from`: "walking left N to shoot it first"), `MAX_FIGHTS` shots in a row at most; else waited out where it clears the landing within `WAIT_AHEAD` (`LAND_WAITS` looks, only where none can reach her meanwhile; the landing judged later with its sightings as old as they are, where as first built shifting them aged them past `STALE_S`); else she goes. Telemetry has the 'landing' events (shot first, waited, went). (From 2026-10-28 the shot only where her attack reaches it from where she'll stand, else the log says why: below.) `_meet` doesn't walk to shoot first: with it, a scenario of 25 up onto 24 with a Green Mushroom by 24's middle (8 seeds) was hurt 14 times and 56 s on its trips against master's 8 and 17 s, the Green walking off the place a star from 25 reaches it from (24's floor stops one from most of 25). The grind's stops can stand clear of their own platform's spawn points (`patrol.STOP_SLACK`, off: in the simulator it cost grinding 4.3% of its EXP, se 2.4%).

**Up close** (`stance.move_limits`, `WALL_ROOM`, `MAX_MOVES`, `AWAY`, `Danger.free_points`, `ESCAPE_STEPS`; `fight.move_room`, `MOVE_LIMITS`, `moved_away`, `Pace.hold`, `Aim`, `HOLD_HIT_SHOWN`, `FLINCH_HOLD_S`). Her moves away keep to `move_limits` where something counts as a danger, in the hunt loop's and grinding's fights and now in `fight.clear`'s too (the tours', the escort's: as first built 50 from every end there): `WALL_ROOM` (25: her half width and her dot's slack) from an end a wall rises from, `EDGE_MARGIN` (25) from a short drop, `DROP_ROOM` (100) from a long one (on 24 201-285 for 226-260). No step away, escape step or jump back ends within a respawn's body of a spawn point of her platform the look's monsters don't account for (`Danger.free_points`; her kill's monster not seen dead yet, kill-place's `touch`, doesn't account for its point, the one due back there: as first built the escapes and jump backs weren't held to it, and on master's grid of her x and a Horny Mushroom 18-45 off either side, jump backs onto 7's wall-side point went from 3 to 33). `MAX_MOVES` (2) steps away in a row without a throw, where something counts as a danger (as first built on the first map too), counting only a step away from a close one (`('back', side, units, AWAY)`; not `_step_from_under`'s out from under one above). Her running attack's target (`fight.Aim`, `h.aim`, declared on the hunter) stands in her pace from when its damage shows (`DAMAGE_SHOWS_MS`) to `FLINCH_HOLD_S` (0.9 s) after the key only where a look from then shows its bar lower than at the decision, and until such a look half the window; matched where the hold has it (walked from the decision's look until her hit shows: as first built walked on through the hold, so it dropped out from about 0.55 s); a jump back's throw holds nothing. Live, of the non-kill throws at walkers 120-300 off (`diag-move-away/flinch.out`), those hurt at +0.3 s came on 17 units by 0.6 s and 19 by 0.9, those not hurt 36 and 43, those not read 52 and 69: held whatever, two thirds of the holds had it come on 10-45 units less than it did. From a Horny Mushroom the escape weighs every 20 of a step from `STEP_ROOM` (40) up to the room there is and takes the safest end (`ESCAPE_STEPS`).

**The simulator** (as built on 2026-10-28; since 2026-10-31 `walkers`' monsters chase her only once she hits them, as the game has it: Its monsters, *A monster she hits chases her*) (`world.Realism.chase`, `invulnerable`; `CHASE_TREE`, `CHASE_STRETCH`, `CHASE_HOVER`, `CHASE_LEAVE`, `INVULNERABLE_LIVE`, `RESPAWN_LIVE`; the harness's `--world walkers`; `World.land_log`, `KNOCK_FALL_MS`, the harness's `landings`, `landing_events`, `moves_away`). In `--world walkers` a monster on the platform she's about within 300 of her walks its next stretch at her a fifth of the time unhurt, 0.6 once her stars have hurt it (`CHASE_TREE`), 1-4 s at most, until its body is 5 into hers; one that reaches her (or is on her) hovers there 0.5-1.5 s and then walks a stretch away from her (`CHASE_HOVER`, `CHASE_LEAVE`: by eye live, 41 cases, those that reached her hovered 0-40 off for 0.5-1.5 s and walked back); a touch leaves her 1.25 s (`INVULNERABLE_LIVE`: no two of the 800 live HP drops came closer, 45 at 1.25-1.5 s); and a monster is back 17 s after its kill (`RESPAWN_LIVE`, the live median on 23). **The shoot-first, fixed (2026-10-28; `FightOnTheWay.shot_place`, `reaches`, `jump_reaches`, `dying`, `throws`; `stance.place_to_shoot`, `_reached_from`, `SHOOT_SLACK`; `navigator._clear_landing`; `flow._drop`, `_jump_up`, `SPREAD_FROM_SPOT`; `D:/MapleHelper-scratch/lshot/checks/shot`, `lshot/fix`, `lshot/mine`).** At 00:38:36 her log said "horny-mushroom at x 24 by her landing on 23: shooting it first" and nothing was thrown: 23 lies 117-122 under 21, past a star's band (`reach.SHOT_DOWN` 60), so from nowhere on 21 does a star reach it; the line came before `clear_for` and `shoot_from`, which both found no throw. She waited a look (its walk as seen cleared the landing), went on a price of 0 at the keep-off's edge (169.1 off by her first attack against 168.8: the walker had stopped at -13), landed 53 off it, jumped back throwing and killed it in 3 throws, not touched by it. Faults, fixed (the first three as first built, the rest the reviews'):
- **A shot first only where her attack reaches it** (`shot_place`): from where she stands by the fights' own rules, a throw from the ground (`reaches`: reach.can_hit, `clear_for`'s, what her profile's attack geometry 'star_search' names for the thief; the seam S1's aim facade replaces) or a jump throw the stance would make there (`jump_reaches`: `stance.jump_hits` over `jump_cover`, `Hunt._jump_hits`' terms, where her attack is made from a jump: not the magician's), else from along her platform within `SHOOT_WALK` from the ground (`place_to_shoot`, `shoot_from`'s: "shooting it first from x N"; a jump throw at each place would cost a coverage each, about 15 ms), and never at one the ledger has dying (`dying`: no fight takes it for a target). Where there's none the log says so and why, and nothing is sent: "no shot first, no throw from the ground takes it from anywhere on platform 21 (it's 125 under her), nor one from a jump where she stands" (the height a fact, not the cause: a floor, a shield or the near limit may be), "... only from x N on platform P, D off", "a monster of platform P in the walk's way to x N", "it's dying (a kill of hers on it): no target" (or `MAX_FIGHTS` tries in a row already, or not in the look). Then, as before, the bounded wait (`LAND_WAITS` looks, where its walk clears the landing within `WAIT_AHEAD` and none can reach her meanwhile: the live Horny was predicted to walk on and stopped, and the baseline found waits of up to 3 s would have made only 6% of the not-sure landings sure, so it isn't longer), else she goes, now with a log line saying why ("landing on 23 by the horny-mushroom anyway (price 1.2 s): its walk as seen doesn't clear the landing within 2.4 s", or the waits used up, or not safe to stand and wait). One 'landing' event a decision ('shot first', 'none thrown', 'waited', 'went', as the harness counts them) with `shot` (why no shot), `why` (why no wait, or why none was thrown), `price`, `clears_s` (a wait's), `at` (the place), `throws` and `kills` (a shot's).
- **A shot only where it threw** (`Escort.throws`, the report's throws before and after): every try came back as 'shot first' and counted as a shot whatever it threw (the reviews': live at 00:44:09 `_meet`'s `clear_for` logged "could touch her on the way: shooting it first", its fight "nothing in reach", the Green missing from its own looks, nothing thrown; in `nav_tree_landing_shot_first` both of the landing's shots first threw nothing). Now a try with no throw logs "none thrown at the K by her landing on P: the fight's looks didn't have it in reach" (or the walk's look), emits 'none thrown', and still counts toward `MAX_FIGHTS` and looks again (she may have walked or stepped, and time has passed); after the walk `shoot_from` says why it threw nothing (the look not finding it again, or it out of reach from where the walk left her), and its fight takes a jump throw too.
- **The walk's place inside the reach, not on its edge** (`SHOOT_SLACK` 6 either way): the nearest place lay on the reach's edge, a median 6.5 inside it on Tree Dungeon's trip-ending legs (11% under 3, the review's margins.py), and the walk is open loop (live 86 steps ended a median 3 off their goal, half of them short; the harness's jitter 6): from 23 at -100 a Green on 22 at -60 was walked to 38, where 37.5 is out of reach; in the simulator 5 of 24 such walks ended out of a throw from the ground's reach, 2 of 24 to 48 now (both with the Green walking; with the fight's jump throws all 24 threw: `lshot/mine/walk_shot.py`).
- **Her jump attack counted** (`jump_reaches`): from 25 at 100 a Green on 24 at 250 is out of every throw from the ground on 25, and the fight jump-throws at it in place; `shot_place` had said 'from nowhere' (the review's jump_clear.py: in 4 of 9 simulated tries the fight killed it with one jump throw); on the fix the two agree in 9 of 9 (`lshot/mine/jump_clear.out`). The jumps straight up 25 -> 24 are the leg the baseline found landing her by monsters most. `_meet`'s own `clear_for` stays from the ground (`MEET_JUMP_SHOTS`, below).
- **None at one dying** (`dying`): in `nav_tree_landing_shot_first` `_meet`'s shot first killed the Horny Mushroom by her landing, and its body, dying there, still priced the landing; the landing's shot first fired twice at it, each fight "nothing in reach", 1.3 s. Now "no shot first, it's dying", and she goes at once (the landing's price itself still counts a dying one: not changed, below).
- **The walk's place judged where she'll stand**: `shooting_place` had her height where she was and a walk goal's reach (`_clear_from`: `SHOT_RANGE` + 15), so on 25's slope (10 higher at 89 than at 140) a Green on 24 at 260 was "in reach from 89" from 140, where from 89 it isn't: she would walk 51 and `clear_for` find no throw (counted as a shot, 0 kills). Now each place by `reach.can_hit` at that place's height and the shot's reach (`_reached_from`). The stance's own approach and step goals (`_close_in`, `_step_from_under`, `decide`'s walks) still use her height where she is: they're decided again every look; not changed.
- **A drop's and a jump straight up's other take-offs tried from their own spots, behind `flow.SPREAD_FROM_SPOT`, off** (`flow._spread`, the landing price's search): `at` was only where she'd rather stop, and standing (or sliding to a stop) anywhere in the clear stretch she went from where she stood, so every spot gave the same move. The live drop from 42.3 was the only one tried; from 60, a step of 18, it lands 181 and 192 off the two Horny Mushrooms by her first attack, clear (cost 1.41 s against 2.15). Replayed on the run's 314 chains, 7 change. In the harness (below) it leans the wrong way in grinding, so it ships off, as master's: the user's call.

## Touches: her popups, MISS or damage, and her invulnerability after one (from 2026-10-28)

The user, 2026-10-28: "The thief job has high evasion which means a good portion of hit were a MISS. That explains why I don't see much evasion manuevar at all. A hit should be indicated by touching the mob, usually the game UI will show a purple-ish MISS or a number with knock back showing the damage taken. After a MISS or HIT the character is invincible for a short period (confirm the duration from extracted game mechanisms, online or local)". Until then a hit was her HP bar dropping (`worldstate`'s `hp_drop`, the navigator's `HIT`, the hunter's `hit_at`), so every MISS went unseen and nothing reacted to it: half her touches. A detector existed (`hud.touch_popup`, purple px in one box over her tag) that nothing called during a hunt.

**What it does now.**
- **Perception** (`perception/touches.py`, `TouchWatch`; in the frame step, `worldstate.TOUCHES`): every frame, the violet text lines around her name tag (`lines`: blue-violet at the top, as the game's NoViolet popups are; her own orange numbers and the criticals' pink-red don't pass); a line born centred on her tag (`BIRTH_DX` across, its bottom `BIRTH_DY` above the tag's middle, or `BIRTH_DY_PLACED` with her tag placed by the camera; a little off, `EDGE_DX`/`EDGE_DY`, once it has lasted `EDGE_FRAMES`) is a touch of hers; one continuing a popup seen in the last `LOST_S`, or born within `REFRACT_S` of one of hers told at its place (re-found after her own numbers hid it), or as near a number still waiting for her HP bar and not read MISS (`NEAR_HELD`, from the review), isn't a new one. What it says is read against the game's own sprites (`Reader`: Effect/Effect_000.wz BasicEff.img `NoViolet0/Miss`, `NoViolet0`'s digits, `NoViolet1`'s first digits, read from the game data copy as the step is made, 0.4 s; without the copy, MISS by width, `MISS_W`): a MISS is told in the frame it shows; a number once her HP bar moves (`HP_WAIT_S`: none of 135 damage touches had none), and a number with her HP the same is another player's (they stood on her), an unread one-frame flash a skill's. Each touch is a `touch` event (its `kind` MISS, damage or `?`, the digits as `text`, `at` when its popup showed, `late`, `how` 'popup', its box and offset), and every state carries the newest (`WorldState.touch`, with `told`: a glance at any later frame knows of it). Her HP dropping with no popup of hers told within `TOUCH_SAME_S` (1.0 s) is a touch too (`how` 'hp': her tag not found, a window over her head), and a popup that soon after one is that one. `hp_drop` is told beside it as before. The perception service says each in its log ("touched: MISS", "touched: damage 54 (0.07 s after its popup)"), publishes each as a telemetry event 'touch' (`touch`, `at`, `how`, `number`, `late`, `dx`, `dy`), and its 10 s line has "touches N (M MISS)".
- **The stack.** `Senses` keeps the newest touch any look or glance had (`touch`, `touched_since(t)`, `invulnerable_until()`; and `touch_listeners`, called with each new one at once: a hook for the mover's moves, which nothing watches yet). The hunter's `_touch_told` (`_touched` as built; master's `_touched` is her HP number's exact touch, behavior.safety's): every touch is her last (`hit_at`, `hit_kind`, `touch_at`), counted in the report (`touches`, `misses`: "touches: 9 (5 MISS)"), sent as a telemetry event 'touch' with its kind (where it was 'hit', her HP dropping), and logged ("touched: MISS, HP 85%"; "; standing still: pushed +0 units" with no key pressed since the look before, kept in lab/hits.jsonl with its `touch`); one that took HP is her last knock (`knock_at`: `knocked()`, the jumps and steps that wait for a knock to end, her heading after a knock, the regular attack's key check passing over her presses about it as about her HP dropping before; a MISS moves her not at all); with a feed that tells no touches (a perception service not restarted), her new HP drops are her touches as before (`_untold`). The navigator: a touch told after the look a chain was planned from cuts it short as a hit always has (`TOUCH_CUTS`: "touched (MISS: HP 92% -> 92%): plan cut short", every key let go, the queued chain withdrawn, on a rope "touched on the rope ...: up again"), her HP dropping with none told still does (`HIT`), and a move or chain she was touched on counts as touched on the way ("touched (damage 54: HP 92% -> 85%) on the way: ..."; `trip.hits`, the 'moved' record's `hit` and `touch`). And no touch counts on the legs she plans while her invulnerability after one lasts (`IMMUNE`: `flow.Flow.immune`, the plan time it lasts to from the latest the chain can start, her lock held back, `IMMUNE_MARGIN_S` 0.15 s less): a chain may pass a monster then, a monster coming into its way then isn't one (`_coming`), and the chain's line says so ("(invulnerable for 0.90 s)").
- **The simulator.** A touch leaves her `INVULNERABLE` 1.45 s (`perception.touches.INVULNERABLE_S`; 1.0 coded until now, and `--world walkers`' `INVULNERABLE_LIVE` 1.25 from the HP drops, now the same 1.45), a MISS as much as damage. Her MISSes by this game's own hit check where her avoid is known (`Her.avoid`, `game_hit_chance`; `LEVEL_25_AVOID` 58, fitted: a Green Mushroom's touches MISS 52%, a Horny's 26%, where `EVADE_ACC` had 34% and 29%); elsewhere (the first map, West Rocky Mountain II) `EVADE_ACC` as before. Each touch's popup is drawn into the frame as data for `POPUP_S` (`fakes.Screen.popups`) and `fakes.FakeTouches` tells it in the first frame that shows it, MISS or the HP it took, as the frame step's `touches`. The harness counts `misses` (hers: `touches` - `hurt`), `touches_told` and `misses_told` (the touches the stack was told of: its 'touch' events), and its `nav` the cuts for a touch (`cut_touch`) and for a MISS (`cut_miss`).
- **Not changed.** The safety stop (HP-based: another workflow's). The stance and the danger model (`attack.stance`, `attack.danger`: her fights decide each look on the monsters about, a MISS's monster among them, and know nothing of the window; `Hunter.invulnerable_until` is there for them). The mover's moves alone (`control.mover`: unwatched; a touch on one is counted after it). What the walk check (D:/MapleHelper-scratch/qawalk) found to fix next is a follow-up's: an evade step instead of going through when her spot is unsafe, the mover's moves watched and cut on a touch (`Senses.touch_listeners`), avoid mode's ways around (`_around`), the monsters the planner lacked (the toucher in its danger list in 3 of 29), the perception fixes. (Built since, but the perception fixes: Evading, below; the stance's fights get clear of the monster on her within the window there, `stance.FIGHT_CLEAR`, and the mover's moves are watched, `Mover.watch`.)

**The mechanics, with their sources** (D:/MapleHelper-scratch/touch/mech: the copies kept with their licences in `src_keep/`, meowdb's pages and code in `web/`, `tools/hitodds.py`):
- *Invulnerability.* meowdb's page on this game's damage taken (meowdb.com/msclassic/formulas/damage-taken, read 2026-10-28; its calculator in `/_next/static/chunks/5253-55d732b50373fb0d.js`): "Invincible after a hit: 1.5 s", and a monster attack that misses or is blocked "gives the same 1.5 s"; no job or level term. The port of the decompiled v83 client (neeerp/RustMS 05448f1a): every touch or attack that resolves, hit or miss, `invincible.set_for(1500)` (`Char.cpp:957-961`; `Char.h:430-432`, FUN_009581a9; `Player.cpp:1256` `become_invincible(damage > 0)`, blinking only after damage), and while it lasts touches aren't checked at all (`Stage.cpp:606`, `:628`: no roll, no popup, no knock). HeavenClient (by hand, not decompiled) has 2 s. The frames' figure, 1.45 s, is the one used (below).
- *Knockback.* After damage only: `knockback = !missed && state != DIED` (RustMS `Player.cpp:1266`), away from the monster's x, not turning her; v83 knocks her off a rope (`Player.cpp:1271`), this game doesn't (11 of 11 live hits on a rope, 2026-10-26).
- *Her MISSes.* This game's hit check, meowdb's 'incoming-hit' and a reading of this game's client binary (ohmi69/osms_datamine_dashboard 17dc5dc1, `tabs/formulas-mob-hit.js:1-38`, "outcome routine 0x140268140"; `tabs/formulas.js:126-136` avoid, `:673-703` monster accuracy) agreeing: G = max(0, her level - its level), A = acc x 100 / (5 (G + 51)), E = avoid / (1 + avoid/80) / (1 + G/40), f = 0.15 + 0.2 / (1 + exp((A - E)/12)); it hits where A R >= E for R uniform in 1 +- f (a rescue roll where E is past A (1 + f)), and one that failed still hits 8% of the time (a MISS at most 90.2%). Her avoid, trunc(LUK/3) + trunc(DEX/6) + 5 plus Nimble Body and equipment, is on her stat window, not her HUD: fitted to her MISS shares on the frames (below) by most likelihood, one avoid for both kinds a level (the formula fits both): level 25 58.1 (one sd 55.9-60.4; Green 36 MISS of 71, 52.5% by the fit; Horny 13 of 46, 26.3%), level 28 70.6 (68.5-72.8; Green 109 of 152, 70.9%; Horny 35 of 83, 43.9%). v83's avoid/(4.5 acc) doesn't apply here.
- *Touch damage* (unchanged): raw = PADamage x (1.2 + 0.2 u), taken = raw (1 - DEF/(DEF + 300 + 2 raw)) - DEF/25 - level/10 (meowdb, ohmi69 `formulas.js:757-787`), as `attack.danger.touch_taken`; live her numbers fell in two clusters, Green 46-62, Horny 110-133.
- *The popups* (the game data copy): `Effect_000.wz` BasicEff.img `NoViolet0` (Miss 98x38, origin 49,37; the digits after a number's first, 22-31 x 32-33), `NoViolet1` (a number's first, 25-37 x 37-39), the fill blue-violet (102-119, 34-51, 204-238) at the top to magenta (221-238, 17-34, 187-238) at the bottom, a white rim inside a black one; Etc DamageSkin.img/0/effect has them too. Each digit overlaps the one before; MISS is one flat word. v83 shows one 1 s (400 ms opaque, 600 fading, rising 30 px: RustMS `DamageLayout.h:16-24`), unconfirmed here: with 1.45 s between touches she has one popup at a time.
- *The executable.* `D:/maplestorycw/appdata/MapleStory.exe` is Themida-protected (`.themida` at VA 0x143EBD000 with no data on disk, `.boot` at 0x145277000, entropy about 7.95, holding the entry point 0x145277058): only its headers and sections' entropy were read; the sources above stand in for it.

## Evading: a refuge, not the mover, for a monster in her way (from 2026-10-28)

The user, 2026-10-28, watching a movement-only walk: "Looks like there was no attempt to avoid hitting the mobs" and "I think for the short period I looked at, there was no attempt to even evade." The walk check (D:/MapleHelper-scratch/qawalk_result.json; the qaprep tool, D:/MapleHelper-scratch/qawalk/prep) confirmed it: of walk B's 148 touches, 57% came after `_wait_for_monster` handed a move a monster was in the way of to `control.mover` (which doesn't look at monsters: unwatched, no stop on a touch) when her spot was judged unsafe to wait on or her six waits ran out; 20% on chains the planner thought clear (the toucher not in its list); she never stepped back or turned away. The design (D:/MapleHelper-scratch/evade/design: offline replays of walks A and B, a simulator prototype) ranked the fixes; these are them, built, measured and tuned in the simulator (D:/MapleHelper-scratch/evade/build). Every rule is a switch; False is as before, and with every switch off the runs are master's to the digit.

**What she does now** (`control/navigator.py`, `control/mover.py`, `motion/flow.py`, `behavior/retreat.py`, `attack/stance.py`, `behavior/walk.py`):
- **A move a monster blocks** (the route's first, nothing chained for it; R1, R3, R4). Without an escort (`AVOID`): the way around costs every move of it the same monsters block (`_around`, as an escort's has: `AROUND_ALL`); she waits only where she can stand (`_safe_to_stand`, now to her invulnerability's end and `STAND_PAST_S` 0.5 s more, a second at least: `STAND_WINDOW`; with a second or more of it left a second's check was vacuous, and she "waited" in contact) and while waiting can clear the way (`_worth_waiting`: `WORTH_WAIT`), `WAIT_LOOKS` looks. Else the **evade step** (`EVADE`, `_evade_step`), within `EVADE_S` 3.5 s of the move's first block, its waits in it (`BUDGET_FROM_BLOCK`), and while the trip has more than `EVADE_DEADLINE_S` 4 s left:
  - the **contact rule** (`CONTACT`, `_contact`): a monster seen live (`CONTACT_LIVE_S`) that touches her within `CONTACT_S` 0.25 s whatever she does now (standing, or a run either way), while she isn't invulnerable: the touch is taken as given and the chain planned with the window after it (its time, `INVULNERABLE_S`, less `IMMUNE_MARGIN_S`): through it instead of stalling there ("contact: ..."); once in `CONTACT_AGAIN_S` unless a touch was told since;
  - at the refuge she went to, while it stays safe, a look again `WAIT_S` on;
  - a **refuge** (`_refuge`): the nearest spot along her platform within `EVADE_WALK` 150 units (`EVADE_STEP_MIN` 8 away at least, `EVADE_IN` 22 in from its ends, every `SPOT_STEP` 5; of spots as near, the one her danger model rates safer: `Navigator.danger`, the hunter's) that a step there and standing there `EVADE_HOLD_S` 1.5 s (to her window's end and `STAND_PAST_S` at least) keep clear of every monster ("spot: a step left to x ..."); else a single move off her platform that chains clear and lands where she can stand as long, the trip `EVADE_MOVE_S` 1.5 s dearer at most (no bound in a retreat after a stop; `REFUGE_MOVES`), never back onto the platform her last pass set off from within `PASS_COMMIT_S` 5 s (up past a monster, another there, and a refuge move took her back down: to and fro), the quickest ("move: walk_off -> platform 21 ..."); gone to as a chain watched as any (a touch cuts it), `EVADE_REFUGES` 4 a blocked move at most.
  - Then **past it** (`_go_past`): the chain planned without the monster in the way (`_first_blocker`: walking the chain on, the first move one is in the way of, else the one by its first move's end), one at a time, `PASS_TRIES` 3, else blind; said with why ("pass: NO_REFUGE: ...", "EVADE_S", "EVADE_REFUGES", "DEADLINE"), an `evade` event and a backstop event; watched as any chain. The mover only for a move no chain plans at all, even blind.
  - With an escort (`_meet`): the same evade step from a spot she can't stand on, before her last shot and the pass regardless; the pass regardless goes blind rather than to the mover.
- **The mover's moves watched** (R2, `WATCH_MOVES`; `Mover.watch`, `Mover.clear`): its key plans sent without waiting, glanced at, cut on a touch told since the move began (a MISS too), her HP dropping, or her standing `MOVE_OFF_S` on a platform the move neither leaves nor goes to (`MoveCut`: she replans from where she is, as after a chain cut short). Its run-ups and back-offs (`_climb`, `_run_and_jump`, `_walk_off`, and the walks of `_jump_up` and `_drop`) are checked against the pass's monsters: a back-off into one climbs from under the rope instead (a climb), else the move is refused (`MoveRefused`: it costs `AVOID_SECONDS` as a monster in its way does, not `CANNOT_S`; then the evade step's refuge, else a wait; `REFUSALS` 3 in a row and it goes unchecked). Without an escort the walk to where she's sent on arrival isn't made into a monster (`_arrival_clear`: "not walked on to x ...", arrived where she is).
- **The planner's monsters without an escort** (R5, `UNSEEN_AVOID`; an escort's have them since 2026-10-26): her memory's where the chain goes, the feed's tracks out of sight, the last cut's monster; a look's monster walking as the feed follows it where the look's own tracker can't tell yet (`_walking`: 51% of the danger entries in walk B); one the look placed on no platform (a slime's hop, a knock: walk B's 345) put on the one under its feet (`_on_platforms`, `PLACE_REACH` 40); and the ghost guard (`_ghost`): a track out of sight on her `GHOST_S` 1 s or more, with no touch told in `GHOST_S` while she can be touched, is none.
- **The small fixes** (R6): a run-up's stop or step back is a span of its own in the leg's path (`flow.RUNUP_SPANS`, `_via`: as one straight span from where she stood to the takeoff, up to 23 units behind her went unchecked); a hop over a monster whose walking isn't known is timed as if it walked at her (`flow.HOP_AT_HER`); a chain queued on the move whose first leg is a drop or a climb is checked against the feed's newest tracks two glances before it starts, withdrawn if its flight, landing, climb or the rope's top meets one (`QUEUE_CHECK`, `_queued_meets`; it never fired in the walks measured); touched on a rope (`CLIMB_ON`), the rope's top is looked at when she'd get up there only after her window (`CLIMB_LOOK`, `_top_taken`): a monster there then, and she goes down the rope again ("touched on the rope 40 under its top, a green-mushroom by its top: down again"); within the window, up as before (the touch left her the window, and the next pass gets her clear: as first built it went down there too, and `nav_tree_rope_hit` took two touches more).
- **Her retreat dodges** (R7, `retreat.DODGE`): its trips are the navigator's that avoid monsters, so all of the above goes with them; besides, their chains keep clear of the monster that touched her last (`go`'s `toucher`: a stand-in at her x where the look has no monster within `TOUCHER_NEAR` 40 of her, its walking not known, of the map's kind that touches hardest, while the touch is `TOUCHER_S` 2 s old at most; in the prototype's retreats the first chain was planned without the Horny Mushroom hidden under her sprite that had touched her three times, D:/MapleHelper-scratch/evade/design/trace_loop2.txt); the evade step's budget is the time the retreat has left (a stop's: to the player's window; the Lie Detector's `EVADE_S` at most); after a stop she waits at a refuge rather than go past a monster while one is there (no bound on a refuge move, no pass for the trip's deadline: `deadline_pass`; a trip that times out there is "timeout (at a refuge)"); her memory's monsters too, ties between refuges by her danger model; and `choose` weighs each place's way: a move of it by a monster of the look (`WAY_NEAR` 60 of where it sets off or lands) costs `WAY_BLOCKED_S` 2 s more (`_way_cost`).
- **Fights** (R8, `stance.FIGHT_CLEAR`): touched, her invulnerability on at the look (`Pace.window`, from `fight.pace_of`; over `CLEAR_MIN_S` 0.2 s), the nearest monster on her platform too close for a throw from the ground in contact with her (its body on hers then, `CONTACT_SLACK` 10 more), of a kind that counts and not about to die (its HP bar over `KILL_BAR` 0.25): the escape decides (`_escape`), staying put `CLEAR_STAY` dearer, whatever the kind's keep-off: a jump back, throwing, where a short step to where her next throw takes it was (a Green Mushroom 50 off: ('back', 45) before, ('jump_back') now).

**After its review (2026-10-29).** The review (D:/MapleHelper-scratch/evade/review) read the branch at 8e66576 and found seven things; each was checked against the code and the review's own traces, then fixed, refuted with measurements, or left for later, below. The runs, tables and tools are in D:/MapleHelper-scratch/evade/fix. The branch was rebased onto master 945f201 first (the magician's quick hunt, her stat window, the whole screen 15 times a second, the Lie Detector pushed and texted). The only conflicts were the scenarios' seeds, searched again below. Every new rule is a switch, like the ones above.
- **The Lie Detector retreat "arrived" on a spot where a monster kept touching her** (the review's high finding; `loop_tree_lie_detector_28` seed 9: onto 28 at x 146, the walk on to x 207 refused for a Green Mushroom on 30 that was already touching her at 146, then three touches while the hunt was stopped). Fixed (`ARRIVE_STAND`, `_stand_clear`). For a trip whose x matters (her retreat's place: `go`'s `arrive_waits`, `TripState.hold_x`), the walk on arrival is refused only when standing where she is, for as long plus `STAND_PAST_S`, is clear. Otherwise she walks on ("..., but standing here is no safer: on to x 207"). Where the walk is refused she waits there, a look at a time (retreat's `ARRIVE_WAITS` 30, within the trip's time), for the walk to clear. A trip that ends short of its x says so (`Trip.short`; the retreat's result reads "arrived short: ..."). Other trips (the walk's, where any x on the platform will do) stay as before: there the stand check cost touches (on for every trip, 12 seeds of the walk: +3.9 touches, se 1.6; +5.0 within 2 s).
- **A pass left the blocking monster out for the whole chain** (medium; the retreat after a stop planned her lying on 15 for a drop, with a Horny Mushroom walking at her, past each window: touched 1.45 s apart and dead). Fixed (`PASS_WINDOW`, `_within_window`, `MonsterTrack.counts_from`, `flow.danger`). A pass's chain is kept only if it is clear of that monster once the window opened by its first touch is over (that touch's plan time, her current invulnerability counted, plus `INVULNERABLE_S`, less `IMMUNE_MARGIN_S`). Otherwise it is planned again with the monster counting from then, and that chain's own first touch is checked the same way. Only when nothing chains does the pass leave the monster out entirely, then blind ("pass: ... (clear of it from 1.45 s)"). In the walk this is level (12 seeds, off: -2.5 touches, se 3.5). In the retreat it does not save the review's case: the drop's chain is clear of the mushroom after its window, but the touch it accepts lands before the drop starts and cuts the plan, three times over (the 2-hit question, below).
- **Evade and pass cycles on the same move** (medium; walk 19: a refuge, a 3.5 s wait and a pass into the Green Mushroom, four times in one trip). Built and measured; left off, with the cycles not fixed. `BLOCK_MEMORY` (`_evade_for`, `TripState.blocks`) keeps the evade step's budget and refuges per blocked move (by its key), across passes and chains, until she makes the move or `BLOCK_FORGET_S` 10 s pass without a block; `BLOCK_NO_WAIT` makes a block past its budget go straight to a pass, with no wait. `PASS_AVOID` makes a move dearer after a touched pass (`st.avoid`). Against both off (the walk, 24 seeds, `abl/g-*`): both on gave +3.2 touches a run (se 1.7) and arrived as often. `BLOCK_MEMORY` alone gave +6.4 (se 1.3; it passes sooner). `PASS_AVOID` alone gave -4.2 (se 2.6) but 4.9 points fewer trips arriving (se 2.0). The review's "wait at a refuge only while waiting can clear the way" (`REFUGE_WORTH`) measured worse too: +11.3 touches (se 3.7), +6.5 that hurt. As with `SAFE_PASS` before it, a refuge's wait pays off beyond what `_worth_waiting` can see. The review's count on the same 11 walk seeds, now against the branch before these fixes: 72 of 206 trips (35%) passed one move three times or more, against 77 of 198 (39%), and 74% of passes were touched within 2 s, against 75%.
- **Refuge steps judged clear with the monster under her missing** (low). The review's fix, R7's stand-in for every trip without an escort (`TOUCHER_ALL`), measured worse and stays off. With its walking unknown, its reach left no refuge in range and turned refuges into passes (12 seeds of the walk: +9.3 touches, se 3.2; +8.4 that hurt). A stand-in standing at her x (`TOUCHER_STAND`) gave +2.4 (se 3.7). This is left to perception (the walk check's fix 6: keep the track under her sprite).
- **25 counted as safe under 24's Green Mushroom; the retreat knocked her out of the map from it** (low). Fixed in the retreat (`retreat.OVERHEAD`, `wholly_safe`). A safe platform with a monster's platform above it within her height is weighed by its places' danger, not treated as safe anywhere on it (attack.danger counts a monster above her: on 25 its danger is 0 up to about x 219 and 0.07 past it). A place on a platform is also weighed by its danger within `PLACE_SLACK` 20 of its x either way, taking the worst, because her walk there stops within ARRIVE_TOLERANCE of it (from 24 at 231 the place chosen was 219: danger 0 there, 0.071 at 224; now it is 199). `MapModel.safe` itself is unchanged: spots, grinding, the key check's quiet moment and the tour all read it, so their goldens and EXP would move with it. That is left for a follow-up. The scenarios' `safe_there` now uses `wholly_safe`. With these, `loop_tree_lie_detector_28` on seeds 1-13 has her on a safe place 10 s after the sighting on all 13, with no falls (every switch off: 13 too). The review's falls came from the code before the rebase.
- **The live check's baseline** (low). check_walk.py and LIVE_CHECK.txt now compare with walk B minus its 19 touches between separately started `nav` processes: 129 in 15.5 minutes, 8.3 a minute, 85 on blocked moves the mover took, 44 within 2 s of the one before. They also say the like-for-like number is the qaprep tool's by-eye count of the new walk.
- **The mover's drop by a rope's top** (low, older than this branch; the hunt loop's seed 18, 18 onto 19 from x 104-110, the rope at 111 grabbed 11 times). Fixed (`mover.DROP_AT_SPOT`). Where she stands isn't clear of a rope's top and no spot over the platform below is, so the drop goes from the move's own spot, walked to exactly; the same applies when a walk to within 20 of it would stop at a spot that isn't clear. Found alongside it: the same loop in a chain's drop onto a rope's top below (seed 10: 28 onto 30 by its rope at 146, 12 times in 57 s). Fixed with `ROPE_DROP` (`_rope_drop`, `_pricing`): a drop that ended on a rope costs `CANNOT_S` for the rest of the trip and is no longer offered to a chain as an alternative way. Seed 10's EXP a minute went 115 -> 271, seed 18's 215 -> 299.
- **Found: on a rope just under its top, every chain cut 0.12 s in** ("off the path (still ...)", sooner than STUCK_S: 112 times in 4 minutes on the walk's seed 9 with TOUCHER_ALL off). Fixed (`ROPE_CUT`): such a cut from a rope's top now counts as a chain whose dot never moved, so she gets off the rope (`_rope_top`).

**The 2-hit question, measured again** (for the user's decision; `classes/thief.py` SAFETY_HITS is still 3). The table above compared whole runs, whose hunts diverge long before the stop. This one is paired (D:/MapleHelper-scratch/evade/fix/tools/stops6.py, VARIANT `paired`; `paired.py`). Master's hunt runs to the stop, then her retreat runs as master's or with all of this branch: the stop comes at the same time with the same HP in both. Her pet is out of potions and her DEF known (75); set A is the crowd's hunt loop, grinding and tour, seeds 1-24; set D is crowd-17's grinding and tour, seeds 1-36; 5 minutes, zero-walls. Deaths after the stop, and the touches that hurt her after it:

| her retreat after the stop | 3 hits: died (of 144) | touches that hurt | 2 hits: died (of 143) | touches that hurt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| master's | 6 (A 4, D 2) | 101 | 19 (A 10, D 9) | 122 |
| this branch's (the evade step, R7's dodge) | 11 (A 5, D 6) | 122 | 21 (A 9, D 12) | 112 |

At 3 hits her dodging retreat died more often than master's (9 runs died where master's lived, 4 the other way; McNemar p about 0.27) and took 0.15 more touches that hurt per stop (se 0.08). At 2 hits the two are level. Either way 2 hits is clearly deadlier than 3: 19-21 of 143 against 6-11 of 144. In 12 of the 19-21 deaths at 2 hits, the last two touches came 1.45-1.65 s apart, as her invulnerability ran out. **So: keep 3 hits.** The retreat's dodge is no safer than master's retreat in this test, and at 3 hits it leans the other way. Turning it off for the stop's retreat, while keeping the evade for her trips and the Lie Detector's retreat, is the user's call: a switch for that isn't built (the navigator's evade switches are module-wide).
